name: Ti Chitas - A Voz que é Uma Montanha
description: This opera explores the voice as memory and as a boundary between public and private spheres. It focuses on Catarina Sargenta, known as 'Ti Chitas' (1913-2003), a shepherdess, singer, and adufe player from Penha Garcia.
longDescription:
This opera, titled 'Ti Chitas - A Voz que é Uma Montanha', is presented at Teatro do Bolhão in Porto. It is scheduled for November 21, 2026, starting at 19:00, with a duration of 50 minutes and no interval.

The performance is suitable for audiences over 6 years old, with paid tickets required for those aged 3 and above. The opera is about Catarina Sargenta, also known as 'Ti Chitas', a shepherdess and musician from Penha Garcia. Her musical art and creativity were recorded phonographically and cinematographically, and this collection forms the basis for the opera's musical, dramaturgical, and visual composition.

Ticket prices range from 6€ to 12€ for the stalls, with discounts available for 'Cartão Amigo', groups, and individuals over 65, as well as professionals. The venue is located at Palácio do Bolhão, Rua Formosa, 342/356, 4000-249 Porto.
